messages:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026.04.01-rc1 to production finished (0% -> 100%). Starting postdeploy-synths: proxy-smoke, prefill, embed-synth. ETA 4m :rocket:
dmitri: proxy-smoke for usw2 p95 spiked from 45ms -> 1.2s at 2812345800, plus a small rise in 502s (0.05% -> 0.7%)
erin: seeing OOM events on inference-proxy sidecars in usw2 - a few pods restarted, not everywhere
infra-bot: K8s events (usw2):
```
Warning  OOMKilled  pod/proxy-sidecar-9b2c   3m kubelet
Normal   Pulling    pod/proxy-sidecar-9b2c   3m
Warning  OOMKilled  pod/proxy-sidecar-7f1a   2m kubelet
```
jo: stack snippets from crashed sidecar show growing goroutine stacks during high synthetic bursts, suspect synthetic warmup overlap with batch warmups
dmitri: is this limited to synth traffic or real user traffic?
erin: real traffic unaffected by direct errors; error spike correlates with synth job windows targeting usw2 fallback hosts
sre-oncall: i'm throttling synth job to nozones=1 for now to reduce pressure, but we need to decide whether to roll back the sidecar image on usw2 nodes or pin traffic away
jo: can we soft-pin node pool usw2-inference to previous image v2026.03.28 while leaving global rollout live? we can patch daemonset imageOverride on that pool
dmitri: +1. Soft-pin preferred to full rollback. I'll open a patch to annotate nodes and set imageOverride on those nodes only. No drain required, just update daemonset tolerations/selector patch
erin: applied imageOverride to 6 nodes in usw2, controller restarted sidecars gracefully :white_check_mark: 
infra-bot: postdeploy probe update: proxy-smoke p95 dropped back to ~60ms in usw2 within 2m, 502s returned to baseline
jo: recommended follow-ups: 1) add synthetic warmup jitter (stagger synths so not all targets warm up at once) 2) add a night-run that ramps synths slowly to detect memory growth 3) investigate sidecar mem leak under synthetic concurrency (dmitri)
dmitri: creating INF-2026-091 (incident-lite) to track root cause and actions. Pin expiration set to 12h.
sre-oncall: agree with pin for 12h, monitoring. If stable after 12h, we'll lift pin and re-run a controlled synth burst
erin: for release notes: "Observed transient OOMs in inference-proxy sidecars in usw2 during post-deploy synthetic warmup. Mitigated by soft-pinning usw2 nodes to previous sidecar image and throttling synth jobs. No customer-facing errors sustained."
jo: also adding a checklist item to release runbook: "When running synths postdeploy, stagger target zones and ramp to target concurrency over 3 minutes"
dmitri: assigning follow-ups: mem-profiling (dmitri), synth-jitter implementation (runtime), runbook update (releases)
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke summary: proxy-smoke (usw2) degraded -> mitigated by soft-pin and synth throttle; no global rollback; incident INF-2026-091 created
sre-oncall: closing thread for now, will post update in INF-2026-091 and include a short blurb in release notes if not regressed
jo: thanks all, marking this for morning triage and adding to release follow-up board
